title: Search Engine Optimisation
subtitle: A plan for Northfield Joinery
author: Your Name
byline: Prepared for Sam by Your Name
lead: When someone nearby searches for bespoke joinery, Northfield should be the name they find first. This plan puts search engine optimisation at the centre, then widens your footprint with Meta ads, Google search-trend research, and published work on the future of sustainable timber.

blocks.heading: The core: search engine optimisation
rows: Fix everything that stops Google reading the site: speed, mobile layout, indexing, page titles and structured data
A site that is able to rank, and is shown properly when it does
Map what buyers actually search for and give each service its own page
Pages that answer real searches from people ready to buy
Google Business Profile, service-area pages, project photos and a steady flow of reviews
A place in the map results for searches in your area
Clear, well-sourced pages that AI search tools can read and quote
Your name in the answer, not just in the list of links

left.heading: Expanding your footprint
bullets: Meta ads: Facebook and Instagram campaigns aimed at the customers you want, in your area
Google search trends: track rising searches in your field and publish ahead of the demand
Blog articles: regular, practical posts that answer buyers' questions and earn links
Presentations and white papers: in-depth pieces for trade contacts and press

right.heading: Why published work matters now
right.text: Search engines, and the tools people now ask for recommendations, go looking for in-depth, forward-looking material on where an industry is heading. The firm that publishes it becomes the source everyone else cites.
right.note: Each piece is also cut into posts, ads and talks.

blocks.heading: Proposed series: the future of sustainable timber
items: One line on what it argues. Article.

blocks.note: Every piece is researched, sourced, and approved by you before it is published.

blocks.text: access to the website and Google Search Console, your Meta business account, a monthly ad budget, and around 30 minutes per article to talk through your expertise.
